m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What can I do for you, Spellbinder? First the Bees are willing to talk, and now a Mantis asks a favor? These are strange times.
But since it is you who is asking for her, I'll oblige. I do know of a Gardener, but I doubt he'll want to relocate to Bastion.
Barley has been a great friend to us, and we consider him a Burrower. We keep him safe, and he helps us keep the Last Wood alive.
You'll find Barley in his garden just round the corner. And Spellbinder, be patient. Barley can be... prickly. But he grows on you.
Your assault on the Last Wood stops here, you putrid parasite! You Shadow loving goon! You Umbra Legion lickspittle!
Today the plants fight back! Cultivated Woodsmen, attack!
Enough! Have mercy, stranger. The Woodsmen were only doing as I told them.
Now, why have you barged into my garden?
Greetings, Wizard. I note your kind disposition hasn't gotten you killed... yet. :Tsssk:
One of the effects of the Shadow Queen's curse upon Bastion was great harm to the plant life of the area.
Vegetation is essential for camouflage. Of course, others fancy it for things like decoration and food and whatnot.
Now that you have restored Bastion to the Burrowers, their health and morale would improve from the presence of a Gardener.
Go to Last Wood and ask Elizar FireBlade where to find a skilled Gardener willing to restore some of the greenery to Bastion.
Ask Elizar FireBlade if he knows of a Gardener willing to help bring vegetation back to Bastion.
